source.name: FreeSurfer fsaverage aseg whole-hippocampus segmentation
source.coordinateSystem: FreeSurfer surface RAS (vox2ras_tkr), in mm; aligned with fsaverage5 pial surfaces
source.modification: Labels 17 and 53 extracted at 1 mm sampling after a 0.7 mm Gaussian; largest closed component retained, outward normals averaged once. Whole hippocampi, not hippocampal subfields.
